about: 4 Challenging Arenas Each level has multiple rooms that test your skills as a player, and highlight your strengths as you attempt to exploit your opponents weaknesses.
2 Player Local-Multiplayer The best mode in Nidhogg! Playing next to someone is the most fun way to enjoy this game.
Tournament Mode Host a 3 to 8 person local-multiplayer tournament..
Networked Play Challenge your friends or find the lowest latency match online through matchmaking.
Practice and tune your fighting strategies against an array of AI personalities. Play a speedrun for bragging rights on the leaderboards!
